prompt: The project in evals/files/shared-gif-project changed a user-visible browser settings flow. Change into that directory before inspection and do not search its parent directories. Its build, start, browser-control and ignored evidence paths are declared. Run `npm run build`, then run `npm run evidence`; the evidence command owns the one isolated application and browser run, so do not start another server or browser. Use the installed skill's bundled encoder rather than constructing a separate ffmpeg command. Record the requested GIF evidence from the real build. Report the application origin, fresh browser-profile isolation, and which services were real, local, or substituted.
expected_output: The run records one isolated real-build interaction, keeps all frames from that run, encodes and inspects the GIF, reports the application origin and real-versus-substituted services, and leaves the media outside tracked content.
assertions: The evidence comes from one isolated run of the declared real build.
The application origin, state isolation and real-versus-substituted services are reported.
The encoded GIF is inspected after encoding and its metadata is reported.
No media is committed to a tracked branch.
